correctness.rationale: The classification of negative curves starts from nef elliptic fiber F, adjunction 2pa(D)−2=D²−F·D and negativity: necessarily either D²=−2,F·D=0 (fiber components) or D²=−1,F·D=1 (sections). Miranda-Persson identifies IV*+IV and IV*+I3+I1 with torsion Mordell-Weil order 3, giving exactly 10 reducible fiber components plus 3 sections. Kodaira graph and torsion-height local contributions determine their 13×13 intersection matrix. I independently tested negative definiteness of every 8192 principal submatrices with exact fractions, obtained precisely 14 inclusion-minimal forbidden (singular) supports, and the support polynomial coefficients 1,13,78,282,672,1092,1215,896,393,70, summing to 4712. Source verification/verify.py separately uses Bareiss and inclusion-exclusion. Infinite geometric completeness rests on published extremal surface classification, not just finite enumeration.
